translationRepairs: Ashina Helu, qaghan of the Western Turks, attacked the Xueyantuo and was defeated.
Si Yehu Qaghan, qaghan of the Western Turks, attacked the Xueyantuo and was defeated.
肆葉護可汗 is Si Yehu Qaghan; Ashina Helu (阿史那賀魯) is a different, later Western Turkic leader.
Ashina Helu was suspicious and cruel and trusted slander;
Si Yehu was suspicious and cruel and trusted slander;
肆葉護 is Si Yehu Qaghan, not Ashina Helu (阿史那賀魯).
Yili Qaghan had achieved the most, but Ashina Helu, because he was not of his clan, executed him, and thereafter the tribes could no longer trust their safety.
Yili Qaghan had achieved the most, but Si Yehu, because he was not of his clan, executed him, and thereafter the tribes could no longer trust their safety.
肆葉護 is Si Yehu Qaghan, not Ashina Helu (阿史那賀魯).
Ashina Helu also envied Nishuo, son of Moheshe, and secretly plotted against him; Nishuo fled to Yanqi.
Si Yehu also envied Nishuo, son of Moheshe, and secretly plotted against him; Nishuo fled to Yanqi.
肆葉護 is Si Yehu Qaghan, not Ashina Helu (阿史那賀魯).
Shebeidaguan and the Nushibi tribes attacked him; Ashina Helu fled lightly mounted to Kangju and soon died.
Shebeidaguan and the Nushibi tribes attacked him; Si Yehu fled lightly mounted to Kangju and soon died.
肆葉護 is Si Yehu Qaghan, not Ashina Helu (阿史那賀魯).
On wuchen Yu Shinan, Vice Director of the Secretariat, submitted the Discourse on Sagely Virtue; the emperor replied in his own hand, "Your discourse sets the bar too high.
On wuchen Yu Shinan, Vice Director of the Palace Library, submitted the Discourse on Sagely Virtue; the emperor replied in his own hand, "Your discourse sets the bar too high.
秘書少監 is the vice director of the Palace Library (秘書省), not the Secretariat (中書省).
Yuchi Jingde of Tong Prefecture attended the feast; when a man of lower rank sat above him, Jingde said angrily, "What have you done to sit above me!"
Yuchi Jingde, prefect of Tong Prefecture, attended the feast; when a man of lower rank sat above him, Jingde said angrily, "What have you done to sit above me!"
同州刺史 makes Yuchi Jingde the prefect of Tong, not merely a man of Tong.

In the eleventh month on xinsi, Qibi chieftain Heli led more than six thousand households to surrender at Sha Prefecture; they were settled between Gan and Liang, and Heli was made General of the Left Vanguard.

In the eleventh month on xinsi, Qibi chieftain Heli led more than six thousand households to surrender at Sha Prefecture; they were settled between Gan and Liang, and Heli was made General of the Left Lingjun Guard.
左領軍將軍 is the general of the Left Lingjun Guard, not a vanguard.
On gengyin Chen Shuda was made Minister of Rites.
On gengyin Chen Shuda, Left Grand Master of Splendid Happiness, was made Minister of Rites.
The draft omits Chen Shuda's prior rank 左光祿大夫.
Chief Minister Wen Yanbo said, "I humbly wish Your Majesty would always be as at the beginning of Zhenguan—that would be best."
Director of the Secretariat Wen Yanbo said, "I humbly wish Your Majesty would always be as at the beginning of Zhenguan—that would be best."
中書令 is the Director of the Secretariat.
On gengyin Wei Zheng was made Palace Attendant.
On gengyin Wei Zheng, Director of the Palace Library, was made Palace Attendant.
The draft omits Wei Zheng's prior office 秘書監.
In autumn, the eighth month, on yichou, Zhou Fan, Duke of Qiaojing and Grand General of the Left Garrison Guard, died.
In autumn, the eighth month, on yichou, Zhou Fan, Duke Jing of Qiao and Grand General of the Left Garrison Guard, died.
譙敬公: 譙 is the fief and 敬 the posthumous epithet, so the title is Duke Jing of Qiao.

In the eleventh month on renchen Zhangsun Wuji was made Minister of Works; Wuji firmly declined, saying, "I am undeservedly of the empress's kin and fear the realm will say Your Majesty acts from favoritism."

In the eleventh month on renchen Zhangsun Wuji, Kaifu Yitong Sansi, was made Sikong (Minister of Works); Wuji firmly declined, saying, "I am undeservedly of the empress's kin and fear the realm will say Your Majesty acts from favoritism."
The draft omits 開府儀同三司 and blurs 司空 (one of the Three Dukes) with the Ministry of Works.
The Liao of Jia and Ling prefectures rebelled; Niu Jinda, commander of Hanjiang Prefecture, was ordered to attack and defeat them.
The Liao of Jia and Ling prefectures rebelled; Niu Jinda, commander of the Hanjiang garrison, was ordered to attack and defeat them.
邗江府 is a militia garrison (府), not a prefecture.
In spring, the first month, on guiwei, the Türk qaghan Jiali died.
In spring, the first month, on guiwei, Jieli Qaghan of the Turks died.
頡利可汗 is Jieli Qaghan; "Jiali" is a misspelling.
Earlier, the Tuyuhun qaghan Fuyun had sent tribute envoys to court; before they returned, he launched a major raid on Shazhou and withdrew.
Earlier, the Tuyuhun qaghan Fuyun had sent tribute envoys to court; before they returned, he launched a major raid on Shan Prefecture and withdrew.
鄯州 is Shan Prefecture, not Shazhou (沙州).

The emperor sent an envoy to rebuke him and summoned Fuyun to court; Fuyun pleaded illness and stayed away, yet still asked that his son, the Prince of Respect, be allowed to marry into the imperial line;
The emperor sent an envoy to rebuke him and summoned Fuyun to court; Fuyun pleaded illness and stayed away, yet still asked that his son, Prince Zun, be allowed to marry into the imperial line;
尊王 is the title-name of Fuyun's son, Prince Zun, not a "Prince of Respect".

The emperor agreed and required the prince to come in person to fetch the bride; when the Prince of Respect again failed to appear, the marriage was called off, and Fuyun sent troops to raid Lan and Kuo Prefectures once more.

The emperor agreed and required the prince to come in person to fetch the bride; when Prince Zun again failed to appear, the marriage was called off, and Fuyun sent troops to raid Lan and Kuo Prefectures once more.
尊王 is the title-name of Fuyun's son, Prince Zun, not a "Prince of Respect".
Vice Director Li Jing asked to step down on account of illness, and the emperor granted his request.
Right Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs Li Jing asked to step down on account of illness, and the emperor granted his request.
右僕射 is the Right Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs.

In the sixth month he appointed Left Mobile Guard General Duan Zhixuan commander of the West Sea route army and Left Mobile Guard General Fan Xing commander of the Red Water route army, leading frontier troops plus Qibi and Tangut auxiliaries against the Tuyuhun.

In the sixth month he appointed Grand General of the Left Valiant Guard Duan Zhixuan commander of the West Sea route army and Left Mobile Guard General Fan Xing commander of the Red Water route army, leading frontier troops plus Qibi and Tangut auxiliaries against the Tuyuhun.
左驍衛大將軍 is Grand General of the Left Valiant Guard; the draft drops 大.

Moreover, the Prince of Mi, Yuan Xiao, and your other younger brothers are being bowed to by the crown prince's sons, and bowing in return—this confuses senior and junior in the clan rites. They should be instructed in proper ritual."

Moreover, the Prince of Mi, Yuan Xiao, and your other younger brothers are bowed to by the emperor's sons as uncles and bow in return—this confuses senior and junior in the clan rites. They should be instructed in proper ritual."
帝子拜諸叔 means the emperor's sons bow to their uncles; no crown prince is named.
The Western Türk qaghan Tutun died; his younger brother Tong'e She succeeded him as qaghan, taking the title Shiboluo Dilishi.
The Western Türk qaghan Duolu died; his younger brother Tong'e She succeeded him as qaghan, taking the title Shaboluo Dielishi.
咄陸可汗 is Duolu (Qulü) Qaghan, i.e. Nishuo; "Tutun" is wrong. 沙缽羅咥利失 is Shaboluo Dielishi.
When Duan Zhixuan's army returned earlier, the enemy had reached Shazhou before his men even got back.
When Duan Zhixuan's army returned earlier, the enemy had reached Shan Prefecture before his men even got back.
鄯州 is Shan Prefecture, not Shazhou (沙州).
On yisi, an edict ordered Crown Prince Chengan to handle routine affairs of government from the Eastern Palace.
On yisi, an edict ordered Crown Prince Chengqian to handle routine affairs of government from the Eastern Palace.
太子承乾 is Li Chengqian; "Chengan" is a misspelling.

At the Battle of Red Water, Xue Wanjun and Xue Wanche led the light cavalry in the van and were surrounded by the Tuyuhun; both brothers were speared and lost their horses, fighting on foot while six or seven tenths of their escort were killed. Left Mobile Guard General Qibi Heli led several hundred horsemen to their rescue, fighting with all his strength until nothing could stand in his way, and the Xue brothers escaped.

At the Battle of Red Water, Xue Wanjun and Xue Wanche led the light cavalry in the van and were surrounded by the Tuyuhun; both brothers were speared and lost their horses, fighting on foot while six or seven tenths of their escort were killed. General of the Left Lingjun Guard Qibi Heli led several hundred horsemen to their rescue, fighting with all his strength until nothing could stand in his way, and the Xue brothers escaped.
左領軍將軍 is the General of the Left Lingjun Guard, not the Mobile (Valiant) Guard.
General Zhisi Sili defeated the Tuyuhun on the Juru River.
General Zhishi Sili defeated the Tuyuhun on the Juru River.
執失思力 is Zhishi Sili; "Zhisi" is a misspelling.
On yimao, an edict restored the Tuyuhun state and made Murong Shun Prince of Xiping and Wu Gandou Qaghan of Tuyuhun.
On yimao, an edict restored the Tuyuhun state and made Murong Shun Prince of Xiping and Qugulü Wuganduo Qaghan.
趉故呂烏甘豆可汗 is the full title Qugulü Wuganduo Qaghan; the draft truncates and garbles it.
The emperor worried that Shun might not be able to command his people and therefore ordered Li Dalian to lead several thousand elite troops as a backing force.
The emperor worried that Shun might not be able to command his people and therefore ordered Li Daliang to lead several thousand elite troops as a backing force.
李大亮 is Li Daliang; "Dalian" is a misspelling.

Secretariat Director Yu Shinan submitted a memorial arguing that "sages give their parents simple burials not from lack of filial piety, but from foresight: lavish tombs only become a burden to the dead, and for that reason they refuse them.

Director of the Palace Library Yu Shinan submitted a memorial arguing that "sages give their parents simple burials not from lack of filial piety, but from foresight: lavish tombs only become a burden to the dead, and for that reason they refuse them.
秘書監 is the Director of the Palace Library, not of the Secretariat.
Fang Xuanling and others proposed making Liang Wuzhaowang the founding ancestor.
Fang Xuanling and others proposed making King Wuzhao of Liang the founding ancestor.
涼武昭王 is the posthumous title King Wuzhao of (Western) Liang, i.e. Li Gao.
Soon afterward Heli was assigned to garrison the north gate and oversee camp affairs, and was given in marriage Princess Lintao, daughter of Shangzong.
Soon afterward Heli was assigned to garrison the north gate and oversee camp affairs, and married the County Princess of Lintao, a daughter of the imperial clan.
尚宗女臨洮縣主 means he married (尚) a clanswoman (宗女), the County Princess of Lintao; "Shangzong" is not a person.

Secretariat Director Yan Shigu argued that "the imperial resting temple and its rites belong in the capital; for commanderies and kingdoms to maintain separate temples, as in Han times, is not proper ritual."

Director of the Palace Library Yan Shigu argued that "the imperial resting temple and its rites belong in the capital; for commanderies and kingdoms to maintain separate temples, as in Han times, is not proper ritual."
秘書監 is the Director of the Palace Library, not of the Secretariat.
On wuwu, Palace Attendant Grandee Xiao Yu was made Special Advance and again invited to take part in government.
On wuwu, Grand Master of Splendid Happiness Xiao Yu was made Special Advance and again invited to take part in government.
光祿大夫 is the honorific rank Grand Master of Splendid Happiness, not a palace attendant.
On xinchou, the Türk tuo-she Ashina She'er was appointed Grand General of the Left Mobile Guard.
On xinchou, the Türk Tuo Shad Ashina She'er was appointed Grand General of the Left Valiant Guard.
拓設 is the Turkic title Tuo Shad; 左驍衛 is the Left Valiant Guard.

She'er pretended to submit, then led a surprise attack that shattered the Western Türks, seized nearly half their territory, gathered more than one hundred thousand followers, and proclaimed himself Qaghan Dabou.

She'er pretended to submit, then led a surprise attack that shattered the Western Türks, seized nearly half their territory, gathered more than one hundred thousand followers, and proclaimed himself Dubu Qaghan.
答布可汗 is Dubu Qaghan.
Just then Qaghan Yili Shi came to power; She'er's men, exhausted by the long campaign, largely abandoned him and fled home.
Just then Dielishi Qaghan came to power; She'er's men, exhausted by the long campaign, largely abandoned him and fled home.
咥利失可汗 is Dielishi Qaghan (Tong'e She), not "Yili Shi".

An edict settled his tribes north of Lingzhou, kept She'er at Chang'an, married him to the emperor's younger sister, Princess Chang of Nanyang, and put him in charge of the garrison within the imperial park.

An edict settled his tribes north of Lingzhou, kept She'er at Chang'an, married him to the emperor's younger sister, the Elder Princess of Nanyang, and put him in charge of the garrison within the imperial park.
長公主 means Elder Princess; 長 is not a personal name.

On guichou, the emperor reassigned his sons' princely titles: Yuanjing went from Prince of Zhao to Prince of Jing; Yuanchang from Prince of Lu to Prince of Han; Yuanli from Prince of Zheng to Prince of Xu; Yuanjia from Prince of Xu to Prince of Han; Yuanze from Prince of Jing to Prince of Peng; Yuanyi from Prince of Teng to Prince of Zheng; Yuangui from Prince of Wu to Prince of Huo; Yuanfeng from Prince of Bin to Prince of Guo; Yuanqing from Prince of Chen to Prince of Dao; Lingqi from Prince of Wei to Prince of Yan; Ke from Prince of Shu to Prince of Wu; Tai from Prince of Yue to Prince of Wei; You from Prince of Yan to Prince of Qi; Yin from Prince of Liang to Prince of Shu; Yun from Prince of Tan to Prince of Jiang; Zhen from Prince of Han to Prince of Yue; and Shen Zhen from Prince of Shen to Prince of Ji.

On guichou, the emperor reassigned the princes' titles: Yuanjing went from Prince of Zhao to Prince of Jing; Yuanchang from Prince of Lu to Prince of Han; Yuanli from Prince of Zheng to Prince of Xu; Yuanjia from Prince of Xu to Prince of Han; Yuanze from Prince of Jing to Prince of Peng; Yuanyi from Prince of Teng to Prince of Zheng; Yuangui from Prince of Wu to Prince of Huo; Yuanfeng from Prince of Bin to Prince of Guo; Yuanqing from Prince of Chen to Prince of Dao; Lingkui from Prince of Wei to Prince of Yan; Ke from Prince of Shu to Prince of Wu; Tai from Prince of Yue to Prince of Wei; You from Prince of Yan to Prince of Qi; Yin from Prince of Liang to Prince of Shu; Yun from Prince of Tan to Prince of Jiang; Zhen from Prince of Han to Prince of Yue; and Shen from Prince of Shen to Prince of Ji.
Ten of these princes (元景 to 靈夔) are the emperor's brothers, not sons; 靈夔 is Lingkui; 慎 is Shen alone.

In the second month, on yichou, the emperor appointed his sons regional superintendents: Yuanjing to Jingzhou, Yuanchang to Liangzhou, Yuanli to Xuzhou, Yuanjia to Luzhou, Yuanze to Suizhou, Lingqi to Youzhou, Ke to Tanzhou, Tai to Xiangzhou, You to Qizhou, Yin to Yizhou, Yun to Anzhou, and Zhen to Yangzhou.

In the second month, on yichou, the emperor appointed the princes regional commanders: Yuanjing to Jingzhou, Yuanchang to Liangzhou, Yuanli to Xuzhou, Yuanjia to Luzhou, Yuanze to Suizhou, Lingkui to Youzhou, Ke to Tanzhou, Tai to Xiangzhou, You to Qizhou, Yin to Yizhou, Yun to Anzhou, and Zhen to Yangzhou.
Several appointees are the emperor's brothers, not sons; 靈夔 is Lingkui.
Tai did not take up his post; Palace Attendant Grandee Zhang Liang was ordered to serve as acting regional superintendent.
Tai did not take up his post; Grand Master of Splendid Happiness with Gold and Purple Zhang Liang was ordered to serve as acting regional superintendent.
金紫光祿大夫 is the honorific rank Grand Master of Splendid Happiness with Gold and Purple.

After her death the palace offices presented Lessons for Women together with her memorial rites. The emperor read it, stricken with grief, and showed it to his closest ministers, saying, "This book of the empress's is a model for a hundred generations!

After her death the palace officials presented Lessons for Women to the throne. The emperor read it, stricken with grief, and showed it to his closest ministers, saying, "This book of the empress's is a model for a hundred generations!
宮司並《女則》奏之 means the palace officials submitted the Lessons for Women; there are no "memorial rites".
Imperial Secretary Attendant Censor Quan Wanji memorialized: "Rich silver deposits have been found in Xuan and Rao prefectures; mining them could yield several million strings of cash each year."
Attendant Censor for Documents Quan Wanji memorialized: "Rich silver deposits have been found in Xuan and Rao prefectures; mining them could yield several million strings of cash each year."
治書侍御史 is the Attendant Censor for Documents.
In spring, the first month, Prince Yuan Yu of Zan was reassigned as Prince of Deng, and Prince Yuan Ming of Qiao as Prince of Shu.
In spring, the first month, Prince Yuanyu of Kuai was reassigned as Prince of Deng, and Prince Yuanming of Qiao as Prince of Shu.
鄶 is Kuai, not Zan; 元裕 and 元名 are single given names Yuanyu and Yuanming.
Gui's son Jingzhi was betrothed to Princess Nanping.
Gui's son Jingzhi married Princess Nanping.
尚南平公主 means he married the princess, not merely that they were betrothed.
The ministers again petitioned for the Feng and Shan sacrifices. The emperor had Secretariat Director Yan Shigu and others discuss the ritual, with Fang Xuanling making the final decisions.
The ministers again petitioned for the Feng and Shan sacrifices. The emperor had Director of the Palace Library Yan Shigu and others discuss the ritual, with Fang Xuanling making the final decisions.
秘書監 is the Director of the Palace Library, not of the Secretariat.
